category_seo.title: DAO Governance Tokens - Voting Power & Tokenomics | BiuBiu Tools
category_seo.description: Understand DAO governance tokens. Voting mechanisms, token distribution, and governance participation in major DAOs.

faqs.question: What are governance tokens?
faqs.answer: Governance tokens give holders voting rights in a protocol's decisions. Examples: UNI (Uniswap), AAVE, COMP. Voting power typically scales with token holdings.

faqs.question: How does vote delegation work?
faqs.answer: You can delegate your voting power to others (delegates) while keeping your tokens. This helps active community members vote on behalf of passive holders.

faqs.question: Do governance tokens have value?
faqs.answer: Value comes from governance rights, potential fee sharing, and speculation. Some protocols share revenue with token holders. Others have struggled to accrue value.
